### Day 241: Acts 12:1–5
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-241-acts-12-15.html
Passage: Acts 12:1-5
Points:
- Readers often focus on Peter's deliverance, overlooking the devastating sorrow of James's martyrdom.
- John faced profound grief and fear as Herod executed his brother and immediately targeted Peter next.
- Believers inevitably struggle with hard questions when God miraculously spares one servant while allowing another to suffer.
- Seeking God in painful seasons rarely yields easy explanations, but reveals His sovereign, holy presence.
